newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SWISS BANKRUPTCIES RISE 10 PCT IN JAN/JULY.
newsitem.headline: SWISS BANKRUPTCIES RISE 10 PCT IN JAN/JULY.

text.p: Commercial bankruptcies in Switzerland rose 10 percent in the seven months to end-July from the same period in 1996, Schweizerischer Verband Creditreform said on Wednesday.

The organisation, a bureau which gives banks information on the creditworthiness of borrowers, said 2,628 commercial bankruptcy proceedings had been registered in the first seven months of the year, compared with 2,384 in the same 1996 period.
Including non-company bankruptcy proceedings, total bankruptcy cases fell 0.3 percent to 5,529 versus 5,546 last year.
